rallyRaid_tripPlus.title: rally.raid Earth: trip +
rallyRaid_tripPlus.desc: Adds one step (10 m by default) to the trip odometer; hold to repeat.

rallyRaid_tripMinus.title: rally.raid Earth: trip -
rallyRaid_tripMinus.desc: Takes one step (10 m by default) off the trip odometer; hold to repeat.

rallyRaid_partialReset.title: rally.raid Earth: partial reset
rallyRaid_partialReset.desc: Sets the partial odometer to 0 (distance since the last roadbook box).

rallyRaid_wPlus.title: rally.raid Earth: W+ (skip waypoint)
rallyRaid_wPlus.desc: Gives up the current waypoint (it counts as missed) and points to the next.

rallyRaid_wMinus.title: rally.raid Earth: W- (back to missed waypoint)
rallyRaid_wMinus.desc: Goes back to the last missed waypoint so you can still take it.

rallyRaid_start.title: rally.raid Earth: start countdown
rallyRaid_start.desc: Starts the 5 s countdown while you stand in the DSS circle.

rallyRaid_boxPrev.title: rally.raid Earth: roadbook box up
rallyRaid_boxPrev.desc: Scrolls the roadbook display back one box (the trip is not changed).

rallyRaid_boxNext.title: rally.raid Earth: roadbook box down
rallyRaid_boxNext.desc: Scrolls the roadbook display on one box (the trip is not changed).

rallyRaid_boxSync.title: rally.raid Earth: sync trip to roadbook box
rallyRaid_boxSync.desc: Sets the trip to the km of the box on the roadbook display (you are at that box).

rallyRaid_recce.title: rally.raid Earth: recce mode on / off
rallyRaid_recce.desc: Starts or stops recce mode: the driven line and the car's jumps, crests, compressions, soft sand and slopes are recorded as roadbook changes (rallyraid/recce/<stage>.recce.json).

rallyRaid_recceDrop.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, box here
rallyRaid_recceDrop.desc: Drops a roadbook box at the car's position and opens the quick-pick (press again to save it as it is).

rallyRaid_recceConfirm.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, confirm nearest box
rallyRaid_recceConfirm.desc: Marks the nearest roadbook box as checked (verified).

rallyRaid_recceMove.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, move nearest box here
rallyRaid_recceMove.desc: Moves the nearest roadbook box to the car's position and trip km.

rallyRaid_recceRetag.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, retag nearest box
rallyRaid_recceRetag.desc: Opens the quick-pick for the nearest roadbook box (symbols, danger, notes).

rallyRaid_recceDelete.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, delete nearest box
rallyRaid_recceDelete.desc: Deletes the nearest roadbook box (recorded as a change; undo with Ctrl+Shift+Z).

rallyRaid_recceUndo.title: rally.raid Earth: recce, undo
rallyRaid_recceUndo.desc: Takes back the last recce change.

rallyRaid_repairMenu.title: rally.raid Earth: repair menu
rallyRaid_repairMenu.desc: Opens / closes the rally repair menu (rally.raid Earth Repair app): mid-stage wheel, suspension and radiator repairs, whole-car repair and engine change at the bivouac.

rallyRaid_recoverCar.title: rally.raid Earth: recover car
rallyRaid_recoverCar.desc: In a running stage, car stuck or rolled: shows RECOVER CAR (penalty: 15 min first, then 30 min; recoveries left); press again to confirm. The car goes back onto the route 30 m behind where it got stuck, with the damage of the last recovery state (every 30 s, at least 5 s old). The one reset allowed in a stage.

rallyRaid_gameResume.title: rally.raid Earth: resume saved stage (after a game crash)
rallyRaid_gameResume.desc: After the game crashed or was closed mid-stage: load the stage, press once to see the save (elapsed time, how long ago), again to resume it. After a resume: starts the held stage clock (GO). In a stage: shows the last save. No penalty; every resume is flagged for organizer review.

rallyRaid_rallyNew.title: rally.raid Earth: start a new rally
rallyRaid_rallyNew.desc: Starts a new rally: crash resumes used go back to 0 and an open bivouac is dropped (no key by default).

rallyRaid_plannerMenu.title: rally.raid Earth: open / close the planner
rallyRaid_plannerMenu.desc: Opens or closes the in-game stage and roadbook planner (the rally.raid Earth Planner app must be on the UI layout).

rallyRaid_plannerWaypoint.title: rally.raid Earth: planner - waypoint here
rallyRaid_plannerWaypoint.desc: Planner: adds the next route point (DSS, waypoint or ASS) where the car is.

rallyRaid_plannerBox.title: rally.raid Earth: planner - roadbook box here
rallyRaid_plannerBox.desc: Planner: adds a roadbook box at the car's place on the route.

rallyRaid_plannerRec.title: rally.raid Earth: planner - record the driven line on / off
rallyRaid_plannerRec.desc: Planner: records the line you drive (and its heights) so it becomes the route between your points.
